pattern: ML model deployment requires explicit serving infrastructure: models are not files but services with versioning, routing, and gradual rollout capabilities. Key patterns: (1) Model registry — single source of truth for model artifacts with metadata (metrics, dataset versions, training params); (2) Can ary/AB deployment — route small traffic % to new model, compare performance before full rollout; (3) Shadow mode — run new model alongside production without affecting user experience; (4) Feature stores — consistent feature computation between training and serving to prevent train/serving skew. Key insight: the hardest part of ML is not training but deploying reliably — a perfect model that never reaches production has zero value.
